messages:
Jess: Morning support triage check — tickets at 42 (up +9 since 06:00). Known issue: webhook delivery failures in us-west-2 causing retries and duplicate processing. I bumped the payment-fail macro wording (see link) and flagged high-priority tickets. Any blockers or handoffs?

Omar: Seeing the spike too, looks tied to webhook backlog. Raised priority with routing/infra. Reassigning hot tickets to oncall. Will monitor queue and post updates. :eyes:

Linh: Taking ticket #12489 (payment double-charge). Need payments logs for the last 24h to validate. @Scott can you share the current refund macro snippet so I can reference it in the reply? I'll open a PR to update the macro after confirmation.

Scott: Pushed a PR for the refund macro (refund_v2) with ETA wording and clearer steps. Snippet:
```text
Refund issued within 3-5 business days. If not received, escalate: /escalate refund
```
Added unit test and note in the PR. :thumbsup:

Amy: I cleaned up three stale macros (old-password-reset, legacy-refund, trial-conversion) and added placeholder {{customer_email}} where appropriate. Left inline comments in the macro docs: https://redwood.internal/macros/support

ops-bot: Alert: webhook-error-rate above threshold in us-west-2 — incident INC-2026-45 created.

Omar: Quick mitigation: temporarily reroute webhook delivery to fallback endpoint (will cutover via runbook). Coordinating with infra, ETA ~1h. Will post rollback instructions if needed.

Jess: Thanks — can someone draft the short customer-facing message about processing delays so we can pin it to macros? Prefer one-liner + expected ETA.

Linh: Draft for customer message (posting to #macros-drafts):
"Hi {{customer_name}}, we're seeing a delay in webhook processing affecting your account. We're working on a fix and expect processing within 1 hour. No action required on your side; we'll follow up if we need more info. — Support"

Scott: No other blockers from my side. I'll watch the incident and stand by to rollback the change if the fallback causes issues.

Amy: Today: macro cleanup, AM triage, 09:30 handoff. Blocker: need an export of top-10 recurring support reasons for next week's ops review — @Jess can you export and drop in channel?

Jess: On it, exporting now. Will drop CSV in channel by 10:00. :white_check_mark:
